display.purpose: One hero headline per screen only.

headline.purpose: Section headers, therapist name on profile.

title.purpose: Card titles, therapist name in result cards, modal titles.

body.purpose: Descriptions, messages, form copy. Cap at 70ch.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: Default resting separation of a card from the page background.

shadows.name: lift-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus/press lift on cards and buttons. Warm-tinted, never neutral gray.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets and modals rising over content (message composer, filter sheet).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances, sheet opens, hover lifts. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: pulse-availability
motion.purpose: Slow pulse on the availability dot; disabled entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on a screen (Send message, Search).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #B34625; color: #FFFCF9; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9C3A1D; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(179,70,37,0.14); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B34625; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action alongside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFCF9; color: #2F5D50; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; border: 1px solid #6E6459; border-radius: 999px; padding: 13px 27px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F6E4D8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2F5D50; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The primary discovery input, sticky at the top of search screens.
components.css: .ds-input-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #FFFCF9; border: 1px solid #6E6459; border-radius: 999px; padding: 14px 20px; } .ds-input-search input { border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #2B2622; width: 100%; } .ds-input-search input::placeholder { color: #6E6459; } .ds-input-search:focus-within { border-color: #B34625; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(179,70,37,0.15); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Faceted filter, shown inline above search results. Selected state inverts fill, not just color.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: #FFFCF9; color: #2B2622; border: 1px solid #6E6459; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip--selected { background: #2B2622; color: #FFFCF9; border-color: #2B2622; }

components.name: Availability Pill
components.description: Signature component. Real-time status shown on every therapist photo, before anything else.
components.css: .ds-availability { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #F6E4D8; color: #B34625; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px 4px 8px; } .ds-availability__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #B34625; animation: ds-pulse 2000ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-availability__dot { animation: none; } } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(179,70,37,0.4); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(179,70,37,0); } }

components.name: Verified Badge
components.description: Identity-verified trust signal. Always icon plus label, never color alone.
components.html: Identity verified
components.css: .ds-verified { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: #F6E4D8; color: #2F5D50; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; }

components.name: Therapist Result Card
components.description: Photo-forward primary unit of the search results screen. Never a table row. Availability pill sits on the photo; therapist name uses Title (Plus Jakarta Sans); verified badge is icon plus label.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFCF9; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(43,38,34,0.06); transition: box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(179,70,37,0.14); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card__photo-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-card__photo { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4/3; object-fit: cover; display: block; } .ds-card__photo-wrap .ds-availability { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px; } .ds-card__body { padding: 24px; } .ds-card__row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-card__name { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.3; color: #2B2622; margin: 0; } .ds-card__meta { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6E6459; margin: 6px 0 0; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Nav
components.description: Mobile primary navigation. Icon plus label always together. V1 seeker chrome is Search, Messages, and Profile (Favorites is not an FRS feature).

narrative.overview: peach-finder should feel like a warm, capable person who already vetted this therapist for you, not a directory of contractors and not a clinical booking portal. The system is built around one idea: trust and warmth are not decoration, they are the interface. Every screen leads with a real photo, a real name, a visible verification signal, and a visible available-now state, before it asks the seeker to do any work. This explicitly rejects cold enterprise SaaS defaults, clinical white-and-teal medical portal styling, dense spreadsheet-style directory listings, and anything moody or overly intimate in photography or tone.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream and paper surfaces, never stark white, never cold gray.
One confident peach-terracotta accent for action and availability; a deep pine green carries trust and verification.
Large, real photography with generous whitespace; nothing reduced to a data row.
Soft, pill-shaped, human-scaled components, no sharp enterprise rectangles.
Calm at rest, warm on interaction.

rules.name: The Two-Hue Rule
rules.body: Only two hues ever carry meaning: Terracotta for action/availability, Pine for trust/verification.

rules.name: The Never-Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Availability and verification are never conveyed by color alone; always icon plus text label.

rules.name: The One-Serif Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears only at Display and Headline sizes, never in body copy or UI chrome.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted toward Terracotta or Ink, never neutral gray.

dos: Do lead every therapist card and profile with a real photo, first name, availability pill, and verified badge, in that order.
Do use full-pill shapes (999px) for every interactive control.
Do tint every shadow toward Terracotta or Ink, never neutral gray.
Do pair every color-coded status with an icon and a text label.
Do cap body text measure at 65-75ch and keep Fraunces confined to Display/Headline sizes only.
donts: Don't use navy-and-gray dashboard styling, hero-metric tiles, or identical icon-card grids.
Don't use clinical white-and-teal medical-portal styling.
Don't present therapists as dense spreadsheet/directory rows.
Don't use moody, dim, or intimate photography, lighting, or copy tone anywhere.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text for emphasis.
Don't add a booking calendar or date/time picker anywhere.
Don't use Ripe Peach for small text or icons; use Terracotta Deep instead.
